prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Cenocroca, the ass-bodied, lion-jawed and lion-chested beast with ibex horns that imitates the human voice. Native PNG at least1024 square.
ANATOMY: Exactly ONE head, two eyes with fixed pupils staring forward, TWO long ridged ibex horns swept BACKWARD in open arcs without loops. Lion jaws and chest with coarse tawny fur; the rear half is a grey donkey body with donkey hind legs, hooves and one donkey tail. FOUR quadruped legs total. [cenocroca-c02, cenocroca-c03]
CRITICAL MOUTH ANATOMY: A grotesquely broad horizontal slit opens all the way from one EAR ROOT to the other EAR ROOT, exposing dark throat and tongue. The entire upper biting rim and lower biting rim are SMOOTH CONTINUOUS UNBROKEN IVORY BONE: each is one polished anatomical curved blade, fused with its jaw, shaped like a smooth horseshoe rail. Absolutely ZERO teeth, ZERO fangs, ZERO blocks, ZERO seams or divisions, ZERO beads, no tooth-like sections. Both bony edges remain perfectly smooth throughout their length. The mouth is much wider than a normal lion mouth. [cenocroca-c02]
MOMENT: LUNGE obliquely past the extremely low viewer and turn the head toward us calling, its broad mouth agape. The near cheek and ear-root mouth ending are clearly shown; one front paw flies forward while rear donkey hooves drive off ground.
POWER: Human-voice imitation is represented by the calling mouth only; no visible sound waves or magic. Dust kicked up by a physical lunge. [cenocroca-c03]
SCALE & CAMERA: tight low angle three-quarter composition; huge foreshortened head and lion chest fill foreground, donkey rump and hooves clearly visible behind; normal animal scale, no human comparators.
LIGHT & WEATHER: One dominant warm sunset side light with deep walnut shadows; airborne physical dust.
SURFACE: matted lion chest fur, coarse grey donkey fur, natural horn ridges and flawlessly SMOOTH SOLID bone mouth edges without ANY segmentation.
SETTING: neutral dark dry rocky ground; editorial minimal staging, no invented region.
MOOD: dangerous and imposing; not cute, tame, smiling or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: No text, glyphs, logo, watermark, border or frame; no extra heads or limbs; no movie/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or gore; no generic glowing aura or energy ribbons. THE BONE REPLACES ALL TEETH.
depicted_variant: the ass-bodied lion-chested ibex-horned human-voice creature

EXACTLYTWO curved ibex horns.
Its human-voice imitation lures prey; no visual soundwaves or magical effects. Physical dust rises under lunging hooves/paws.
An unspecified dark rocky lair; no unsupported geography, buildings or additional prey.

aura: Lunge and call toward camera, broad slit mouth revealing continuous unbroken bony bitingridges, fixed pupils directly forward. Claim grounding: cenocroca-c02, cenocroca-c03, cenocroca-c03

artistic_choices.description: Low camera, directional lighting, dark warm palette and fully opaque clothes where applicable are editorial rendering choices, not extra powers.
Minimal dark rocks are editorial staging, not namedhabitat. Assbody/lionchest/ibexhorns are c02 composition; do not substitute Strabo dogwolf c04 or Pliny leucrocotta c07.
Attempt03 uses fresh original composition after editing retained tooth-like divisions. Neutral rocky ground is editorial staging; no magical effects.

rejected_attempts.reason: Mouth bone ridge broken into rectangular tooth-like segments, not one continuous bone c02; horns curl like ram rather than long backward ibex horns.
Attempt02 masih membagi tulang mulut menjadi segmen mirip gigi; mulut tidak membelah hingga telinga c02.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native1254 dan200px dilihat: empat kaki, kepala/rahang/dada singa menyambung badan belakang keledai dengan kuku dan ekor; dua tanduk ibex beralur, dua mata fokus ke depan. Mulut jauh lebih lebar mendekati pangkal telinga; tulang rim bawah halus menyatu dan rim atas menerus tanpa taring/gigi terpisah, guratan dangkal pada ujung samping dibaca tekstur tulang bukan deretan gigi. root_visual_review.notes: Anatomy is right (ass body, lion chest and head, ibex horns, mouth split to the ears with a bone ridge) but the wide toothless split mouth reads as a cartoon grin with calm eyes, i.e. comic rather than dangerous (GAMBAR §6.1 'lucu', §6.4 items 2 and 7). Redraw at night or dusk with the head lowered in a lunge, the split mouth gaping wide as it calls with a human voice, fixed glaring pupils, the bone ridge lit hard; keep every counted feature.
